error_submit_ready_script_failed: Failed to prepare attachment readiness check.
error_unexpected_retry: An unexpected error occurred. Please check file permissions and try again.

error_gws_disabled: Google AI web apps are disabled. Enable them from settings.
error_refresh_failed_requires_login: Google session refresh failed. Sign in to Google again to continue.
browser_fallback_description: This app is designed to run only inside Electron or a desktop environment so it can access the file system and local integrations. Browser preview is not supported.
error_pdf_moved: This PDF may have been moved or deleted. Choose a new location to continue.
error_bulk_not_supported: This provider does not support multiple images in one message. The draft was kept; remove items to send them one at a time.
error_cancelled: The send was cancelled. We could not confirm delivery; sending again would create a duplicate message.
error_cancelled_before_send: The send was cancelled before it started. The prepared content was rolled back; you can try again whenever you like.
error_webview_destroyed: The AI tab closed during sending
error_paste_not_applied: Could not confirm whether the image was attached. Check the AI side; resending may create a duplicate attachment.
error_text_input_partial: Only part of the text landed in the composer. It was not sent automatically to avoid duplicate content; review it and send.
error_text_input_unverified: Could not verify that the text landed in the composer. Nothing was sent automatically; check the box and send it yourself.
error_submit_unverified: The send was triggered but the AI page showed no response, so delivery could not be confirmed. The text is still in the box — check the conversation before sending again.
error_submit_delivery_unconfirmed: The send button was clicked but delivery could not be confirmed. Check the conversation before sending again; resending may create a duplicate message.
